headline: Nothing scores 2 or higher this run. The only in-scope item is a routine PRA form-burden renewal on U.S.-to-foreign-corporation stock transfers (§367/Form 926), capped at score 1.
notes: No IRB issues in this run; all 9 items are Federal Register documents.

2026-21786 (Outbound Investment Security Program) is a national-security proposed rule, not a tax measure and not an AML/ownership-transparency/entity-registration final rule, so no document-number news check was triggered; scored 0.
No final Treasury/FinCEN rule touching ownership transparency, AML or entity registration appeared, so no web searches were run.

items.cite: FR 2026-21921 — PRA: transfers of domestic stock/securities by U.S. persons to foreign corporations
items.plain_english: A Paperwork Reduction Act notice invites comment on the information collection for U.S.-person transfers of domestic stock or securities to foreign corporations (§367/§6038B, Form 926 territory).
items.why_you_care: intl_info_returns/foreign_corp_partnership — touches Form 926 and §367 outbound transfers, but it is a routine PRA form-burden renewal, so capped at skim.
